name: Hand-painted wooden Kavad storytelling shrine, multi-panel folding box (Rajasthan folk craft, approx. 8 in / 20 cm)
supplier_cost_note: No supplier price found. WebSearch 'kavad wooden box wholesale price per piece Bassi Chittorgarh supplier' (seen 2026-11-25) returned only generic wooden boxes (e.g. TradeIndia Faridabad wooden box about Rs 450 + 12% GST, MOQ 10: https://www.tradeindia.com/products/wooden-boxes-c10306808.html), none of them Kavad. Kavad is made mainly by the Suthar/Kumawat artisan families of Bassi, Chittorgarh (Memeraki listing, seen 2026-11-25). Memeraki sells an 8-part Kavad by Satyanarayan Suthar made to order (1-2 weeks) at Rs 900 retail, which shows single-piece made-to-order supply exists but not the trade price. At Rs 1,499, cost must be about Rs 400 or less (about 27%). Needs a written single-piece drop-ship quote from a Bassi artisan.
retail_observed: Specialist retail only (WebSearch snippets seen 2026-11-25): Gaatha 20 cm and 29 cm kaavad shrines Rs 1,850, single-piece shrines Rs 950, small Ganesh/Hanuman single pieces Rs 1,050, red/yellow 29 cm (35x25x25 cm) Rs 3,000, many marked out of stock; IndiaHandmade 'Heritage Story Kavad' (JodhpurArts) Rs 790 special / Rs 980 regular, '1 left'; Memeraki 8-part Kavad by Satyanarayan Suthar Rs 900 (made to order); Exotic India larger Kavad USD 105 sale / USD 175 list. Marketplace price UNVALIDATED: no Flipkart or Amazon.in Kavad listing appeared in two searches.

demand_signals.summary: Two-page category; 20-29 cm shrines at Rs 1,850-3,000, single pieces Rs 950-1,050; many items out of stock. Supports a Rs 1,000+ specialist price point; stock-outs are not sales data.
Rs 790 special / Rs 980 regular, '1 unit left'. A lower price anchor for a small piece; no reviews or volume seen.

demand_signals.summary: Rs 900, made to order with 1-2 week delivery; made only in Bassi, Chittorgarh. Shows a named artisan selling single pieces, but the lead time is long.

demand_signals.source: WebSearch 'kaavad wooden handpainted portable shrine price flipkart OR amazon OR gaatha'
demand_signals.summary: No Flipkart or Amazon.in listing came up, which suggests few marketplace competitors (not proof of absence). Exotic India sells to export buyers at USD 105-175. No Google Trends data checked.

risks: Supplier cost unknown; passes only if a Bassi artisan quotes about Rs 400 or less per piece for drop-ship. Memeraki's Rs 900 retail for an 8-part piece suggests trade prices could be close to that
Rs 1,499 is above IndiaHandmade (Rs 790) and Memeraki (Rs 900) for small pieces and below Gaatha's Rs 1,850 for 20 cm; the listing must be a 20 cm multi-panel piece to justify the price
Supplier in Rajasthan, so website-only under docs/05 (no Odisha APOB possible)
Made to order with 1-2 week lead time (Memeraki); slow for marketplace SLAs and may cause cancellations
Overlap check: depicts deities and epics, so a reviewer should confirm it is not treated as a repeat of idols or wall art; it is a functional folding storytelling box
Toy check: small kavads are sometimes sold as children's toys. List as handcrafted decor for adults or 14+, with no 'toy' wording, so it stays out of the BIS toy QCO and toys_for_under_3
Religious imagery: damage or mishandling complaints can be sensitive; needs a rigid box. Painted hinged panels can scuff or crack in transit
Handmade variation; listing must say 'design and colours may vary'
Weight not stated in snippets; a 20 cm wooden kavad is assumed under 1 kg packed; needs a weighed sample
GST assumed 12% (HSN 4420; may be 5% after the Sept 2025 handicraft rate cut); CA to confirm
Do not claim 'natural colours', 'GI-tagged' or a wood species without supplier evidence
